senses.gloss: f. h. a. ch. (יאי) propriety; adv., (cmp. טַבָּאוּת) right; properly; it is right.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 127:2">Targ. Ps. CXXVII, 2</cite> <he>על י׳</he> in propriety (honestly).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 22:10">Targ. Y. Gen. XXII, 10</cite> <he>כפוס … י׳</he> tie me well.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 13:15">Targ. O. Deut. XIII, 15</cite> (Y. <cite ref="I00025"><he>טבאות</he></cite>, h. text <he>היטב</he>); a. fr.—Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᵈ top <he>וי׳ הרי וכ׳</he> and it is right so; for there is the case &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:4:3">Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ</cite> <he>וי׳ היא</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:1:10">Y. Dem. I, 21ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>י׳ הוא מקשי</he> he asks a proper question; a. fr.
